clauses.why: The verse says some of those from Cilicia disputed with Stephen; it does not call them Jews or say Cilicia had its own synagogue.
clauses.english: had men among those who disputed with Stephen
clauses.ukr: мала людей серед тих, хто сперечався зі Степаном
clauses.deu: hatte Leute unter denen, die mit Stephanus stritten
clauses.spa: tuvo hombres entre los que disputaron con Esteban
